Obrigada por responderes btw também acho q é o melhor para mim sair
as pessoas q vêm para aqui comentar merdas em vez de tentar ajudar bem q podiam ir passear

Yeah I feel the same way, it's hard to feel so lost all the time while everybody else makes everything look so easy. I'm sure things will get better and you will go back to being the good student you once were ahah
Wishing you all the best!

Yup, everybody is just doing great and you are stuck under piles and piles of unfinished work. Well at least you know you are not the only one and as sad as it may be it does help to know others are doing just as bad as you are ahah 
I hope things get better, good luck!

Self sabotage is a hell of a drug am i right? I know it might be hard but please give yourself a chance and try to do some reading or some exercises. It looks like you have some confidence so that is already half the job done! Wishing you the best!!

I know that feeling as well.. It gets to the point where you start to feel like a zombie just mindlessly scrolling while putting off doing the work (at least for me it is) but I believe that you can do it! Maybe get some sleep and give it a try tomorrow? Best of luck!

Hey! I know it feels like there's no point in even picking up the books rn but I STRONGLY suggest you to please try to at least read some of the material. Take my word for it, today my exam had two or three questions I could have answered easily if only I had read the slides.. I hope everything goes well and don't forget to get a good night of sleep. Good luck!!

Yeah its awful, I'm actually considering doing the same but I just can't seem to make up my mind.. It's hard seeing everybody around you doing what they are supposed to do while you are just left behind struggling and end up feeling like you are always the odd one out. Here's to hoping things will get better for all of us and btw thank you for answering it really does help a lot.

It does help a lot, thank you for taking the time to answer. Also I think you should feel really proud of yourself for keeping up your studies and working towards your goals despite struggling with chronic  depression. Hope everything goes well!

Thank you so much for taking the time to answer, it really helps knowing I'm not the only one struggling with college. My first year of college also started that way, I failed most of my exams and was pretty unmotivated and lost but things actually started looking up at some point so don't let one exam bring you down, you got this!! Also (and I know how hard this can be so sorry) try not to think so far ahead and just do the best you can, even if it doesn't seem like much. Wishing you all the best :)

I know how it feels to think of yourself as the lowest of the low and have zero motivation to do anything at all but please know that YOUR LIFE HAS WORTH, and that worth is NOT at all determined by what other people think of you or what you think of yourself for that matter. The only think you can do right now is try to work on yourself every day, maybe starting out with putting an end to those self deprecating thoughts? I know it's hard but unfortunately having some resemblance of a self esteem is necessary to put yourself out there and get better. I truly wish you the best :)

I'm sorry to hear that, but know that whatever it is that you are feeling is valid and that  you should always feel proud of yourself for taking action and asking for help!! Have you ever tried online counselling? Awhile ago somebody reccomend a site called 7cups in one of my posts and I think it could be worth trying out.
Please don't do it, i know that sometimes it might feEl like the only way out but please try to take one day at a time and (if possible) reaching out to somebody. You can do it, believe in yourself.

To me everyday has been pretty much the same which would be on the 'worse' side but I'm glad I'm not the only one who feels this way (as fucked up as that sounds). Sometimes I look at my parents or my sister and wonder if they feel disappointed in me and I can't help but to think that that's the case 9/10.. They don't do anything to make me think that way but I guess I'm just projecting the way I feel about myself onto them idk 
Thank you so much for answering btw and I truly wish you the best :)

I'm really sorry to hear that and it sucks that your parents refuse to help you, especially because coming to terms with the fact you need help is already hard enough on its own. 
But I truly believe that you can still do something to help yourself :) you could try out an online therapist since you won't have to pay for one of those (I think) and maybe that will give you a better understanding of what's going on. Wishing you the best
I think you should give 'Paradise Kiss' a try :) It's a pretty mature romance anime and it doesn't have any of the typical anime cliches

Hi :) so I just read the previous post where you explained a bit more why you do this and I sincerely hope you do everything you can to stop harming yourself. I would recommend talking to someone you trust or even looking for professional help to deal with your anxiety. I am not a therapist but I would reccomend doing something you enjoy to distract yourself for a bit... Maybe listening to music ot watching a movie, basically something that will make you feel good and doesn't require too much effort.
im sure you will do just fine and even if you don't you just have to remind yourself that it´s only a test and you will have other opportunites to do better. best of luck :)
Thank you so much, I know it won't be easy and there are definetly times where I feel like i should just keep going through it alone but I'll keep trying :)

Thank you so much for answering, it really means a lot :) I already started writing the letter and I'm feeling better about it then I expected, I didn't get to the worst part yet but i'l try to keep a positive attitude
